name: team_planning_set_plan_value
description: Hold a person's level or FTE in a scenario of a Team Planning plan in place of the Org Graph's, for a value the HRIS has wrong or that is about to change. An FTE is above 0 and at most 1. The plan keeps the value private to that person, so once they are forgotten it reads as removed. Use team_planning_set_planned_level for a promotion. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as the business reason for a move. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Keep personal details out: deleting the plan erases the note, forgetting a person does not.

scenario_id.description: The scenario, or the plan's id for the baseline.

value.description: A level, or an FTE such as "0.8".
